cases.title: A continuing responsibility
cases.body: Ongoing responsibility for the website within an enterprise marketing environment, across launches, campaigns, and the systems that support them.
cases.chain: problem: no owner across seams → move: single-operator coverage → result: site holds shape between teams → limits: numbers shared on request
cases.attribution: sole operator: platform, analytics, consent, schema

cases.title: A campaign, in context
cases.body: Work on the marketing website and campaign delivery for a contract-management business, including the reliability of its measurement.
cases.chain: problem: measurement broke at the edges → move: consent + embed discipline → result: clean data survives campaigns → limits: baseline pre-dates tooling
cases.attribution: sole operator: consent architecture, tracking QA

cases.title: A portfolio with a common structure
cases.body: A shared publishing structure for a property portfolio, bringing consistency to how information is maintained and presented.
cases.chain: problem: one-off pages decayed → move: CMS as system + schema @graph → result: machine-quotable structure → limits: quoted volume still accruing
cases.attribution: sole operator: CMS architecture, schema design

principles.title: Clarity of purpose.
principles.body: A shared understanding of the ambition, the choices it requires, and the authority to act.

principles.title: Judgement in context.
principles.body: Each decision considered in relation to the brand, the buyer, and the business it serves.

principles.title: Room to grow.
principles.body: A common foundation that allows more teams and markets to build on the work.
